tests.name: 4963/2160回合初异常快照免攻击红伤并按完整被免量授盾，非满HP真实魂印回复41且技能禁疗不封
tests.assertion: test('4963/2160回合初异常快照免攻击红伤并按完整被免量授盾，非满HP真实魂印回复41且技能禁疗不封',()=>{const a=make({move:38618,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000}),b=make({move:38618,index:-1,hp:1000});for(const s of[a,b])s.fighters[0].ailments['疲惫']=3;timer(a,0,'技能禁疗');turn(a,38618,10127);turn(b,38618,10127);assert.equal(sum(a,'attack',1),0);assert.ok(sum(b,'attack',1)>0);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].suitState.shield,sum(b,'attack',1));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,1041);});

tests.name: 4963/2160同源盾刷新本次数额异源50共存，忽略免伤不授盾，其他免伤并存待答明确回滚
tests.assertion: test('4963/2160同源盾刷新本次数额异源50共存，忽略免伤不授盾，其他免伤并存待答明确回滚',()=>{const s=make({move:38618,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});s.fighters[0].ailments['疲惫']=5;s.fighters[0].suitState.shield=50;turn(s,38618,10127);const first=s.fighters[0].suitState.shield;assert.ok(first>50);s.fighters[1].stats.atk=500;turn(s,38618,10127);const amount=s.fighters[0].soulState.cloud2160.grants[0].amount;assert.equal(s.fighters[0].suitState.shield,50+amount);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].suitState.shield>first);const x=make({move:38618,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});x.fighters[0].ailments['疲惫']=3;x.fighters[1].counts.nextAttackIgnoreImmunity=1;turn(x,38618,10127);assert.ok(sum(x,'attack',1)>0);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].suitState.shield,0);const q=make({move:38618,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});q.fighters[0].ailments['疲惫']=3;timer(q,0,'攻击伤害免疫');assert.throws(()=>turn(q,38618,10127),/Q-4963-002/);assert.equal(q.round,1);assert.equal(q.fighters[0].suitState.shield,0);});

tests.name: 4963/2160异常在回合初之后附加不追授本回合免伤，当前自己回复41上限截取且血药独立
tests.assertion: test('4963/2160异常在回合初之后附加不追授本回合免伤，当前自己回复41上限截取且血药独立',()=>{const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,'疲惫',c.t,false,false,2);}};let s;try{s=make({move:38618,index:-1,soul:true,hp:8990});turn(s,38618,10127);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.ok(sum(s,'attack',1)>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].suitState.shield,0);const x=make({move:29499,index:-1,soul:true,hp:8990});turn(x,29499,20117);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].hp,9000);});

tests.name: 4963/2160免普通攻击红不把4000真实冰系属性附伤当作普通攻击免伤，属性附伤仍真实减HP
tests.assertion: test('4963/2160免普通攻击红不把4000真实冰系属性附伤当作普通攻击免伤，属性附伤仍真实减HP',()=>{const enemy=require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4000/snapshot.json'),s=make({move:38618,index:-1,soul:true,enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:[29371,10047,22660,14897,38423],hp:5000});turn(s,38618,10047);s.fighters[0].ailments['疲惫']=4;turn(s,38618,29371);const e=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.round===2&&e.sourceSide===1&&e.redCategory==='attribute');assert.ok(e);assert.ok(e.settledDamage>0);assert.ok(e.hpLoss>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].suitState.shield,0);});

tests.name: 4963全部5招基础分类真实HP/PP/先制与0PP拒绝，有序完整当前2160逐招8种子实际执行
tests.assertion: test('4963全部5招基础分类真实HP/PP/先制与0PP拒绝，有序完整当前2160逐招8种子实际执行',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,index:-1,aStats:{atk:180,spa:18}});turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,m.priority);const es=(s.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='attack');assert.equal(es.length,m.kind==='status'?0:1);if(es.length){assert.equal(es[0].attackValue,m.kind==='physical'?180:18);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000-es[0].hpLoss);assert.ok(es[0].settledDamage>0);}const z=make({move:m.id,index:-1});z.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(z,m.id,20117),/有 PP/);for(let seed=1;seed<=8;seed++){const x=make({move:m.id,soul:true,hp:8000,seed:seed*987654321});turn(x,m.id,20117);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.ok(x.fighters.every(f=>f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}}});
